name: Homosexual
overview: Scripture clearly presents homosexual behavior as contrary to God's design, affirming that God created humanity male and female from the beginning (Mark 10:6) and condemns same-sex relations as an abomination deserving judgment (Leviticus 20:13). Romans 1:26 further explains that such actions are against the natural order established by God. While God's holiness demands justice against sin (Proverbs 17:15), Isaiah 56:3 reminds believers that all who join themselves to the Lord are included in His people, emphasizing the call to faithfulness and transformation. Christ's teaching in Matthew 19:11 acknowledges the difficulty of living according to God's standards, underscoring the need for divine enablement.
